summary: JAMESPaudio is a decentralized “creative social hub” built on the Internet Computer. It consists of a React + TypeScript frontend (Tailwind + shadcn/ui, TanStack React Query, some TanStack Router usage) and a Motoko canister backend. Users authenticate with Internet Identity, create and manage profiles, search for other users, chat via direct messages and group conversations (including per-message styling metadata), track last-online presence, and use a points economy (wallet, transactions, store, daily rewards, and a daily mystery box). The app also includes premium membership (free trial + upgrades), music uploads via IC blob storage (ExternalBlob) with friends’ music discovery, and a “Search Engine Store” for choosing a default search provider with per-user search history. Many additional media/utility pages (videos, movies, radio, live TV, AI song generator, etc.) are implemented as frontend-only simulated modules. The backend also contains scaffolding for Stripe payments and IC HTTP outcalls, plus blob-storage maintenance endpoints and a migration for legacy message data.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider
existing_features.description: Provides login/logout using Internet Identity via @dfinity/auth-client, restores persisted identity on reload, and exposes detailed login status flags (initializing/logging-in/success/error) through a React context hook.

existing_features.title: Identity-aware backend actor creation and bootstrap
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous canister actor for guests and an identity-authenticated actor for signed-in users. On authenticated actor creation, calls _initializeAccessControlWithSecret using a secret parameter extracted from the URL hash/session; invalidates/refetches non-actor React Query caches when the actor changes.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (RBAC) with admin bootstrap token
existing_features.description: Motoko RBAC assigns roles per Principal and enforces authorization. Includes bootstrap initialization using CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN + user-provided secret, plus APIs to query caller role/admin status and to assign roles (admin-only).

existing_features.title: Main application shell with responsive navigation
existing_features.description: Authenticated app shell with a desktop sidebar and a mobile slide-in menu. Uses internal state to switch between major pages, and supports navigating into Groups with an optional targetGroupId for auto-selection.

existing_features.title: App bootstrap gating (loading screen, login gating, profile setup gating)
existing_features.description: Shows a branded loading screen on startup, routes unauthenticated users to a branded login/marketing page, and blocks first-time authenticated users with a mandatory profile-creation modal before entering the main app.

existing_features.title: User profile creation, retrieval, and editing (bio + picture)
existing_features.description: Backend supports creating a profile (username + bio), publicly fetching a profile by Principal, and updating a profile’s bio and profilePicture metadata. Frontend renders Profile page with stats and provides an Edit Profile dialog.

existing_features.title: Public user search by username
existing_features.description: Search page queries backend searchProfiles for username matches and renders results as user cards with profile info and action buttons.

existing_features.title: Presence / last-online tracking
existing_features.description: Backend stores per-user lastOnline timestamps. Frontend periodically updates the caller’s last-online and displays ‘Active now’ / time-ago status in profile and chat partner lists.

existing_features.title: Recent statuses discovery feed
existing_features.description: Feed page includes a ‘What’s Recent’ section backed by getRecentStatuses(limit), showing recent user activity/status for discovery (publicly accessible).

existing_features.title: Direct messaging APIs (send, fetch conversation, list partners)
existing_features.description: Backend supports 1:1 direct messages with per-message styling metadata, querying a conversation between caller and another principal, and returning unique conversation partners ordered by most recent activity.

existing_features.title: Direct messaging UI with polling and last-online updates
existing_features.description: Frontend chat UI shows DM partners, supports searching users, renders conversation messages with timestamps, polls for updates, auto-scrolls to newest messages, and updates the caller’s last-online timestamp on an interval.

existing_features.title: Per-message text color styling in chats
existing_features.description: Implements per-message text color selection (Normal → Black → Orange → Cyan) via a one-tap cycle control in DM and group composers; color is stored with each message and rendered consistently (with backward-compatible defaults for older messages).

existing_features.title: Per-message lightweight text effects in chats
existing_features.description: Adds optional per-message effects (at minimum skull/fiery/devil) selectable in the composer; effects are stored per message and rendered as lightweight decorations (emoji prefix) to avoid lag.

existing_features.title: Send button style toggle in chat composers
existing_features.description: Chat composers in DM and group chat include a clean single-tap toggle between a normal send icon and an emoji-style (skull) send button presentation.

existing_features.title: Groups: create, list, fetch details, and manage membership
existing_features.description: Backend supports group creation and membership management; frontend shows a groups list sidebar, supports selecting a group, and provides create-group and add-member flows with toast feedback and cache invalidation.

existing_features.title: Group messaging with optional media attachments
existing_features.description: Member-only group chat supports sending messages with optional mediaAttachment (image/video/audio metadata) and fetching group messages. Frontend provides a conversation UI with polling and auto-scroll and renders attachments when present.

existing_features.title: Search → start group chat → auto-open group conversation
existing_features.description: From user search results, an authenticated user can create a new group, add the selected user, and automatically navigate to the Groups page with the newly created group selected and ready to chat.

existing_features.title: Group creation UX with in-dialog user search and multi-select initial members
existing_features.description: Group creation dialog supports searching users during creation, selecting multiple initial members, adding them immediately after group creation, and auto-selecting/opening the newly created group conversation.

existing_features.title: Points wallet and transaction history
existing_features.description: Backend tracks points and records transactions (earn/spend/purchase). Frontend Points page shows current balance (from profile), quick stats, and a sorted transaction history with icons and type-based styling.

existing_features.title: Points store (browse items, redeem items, demo purchase points)
existing_features.description: Backend exposes a store catalog and supports redeeming items by spending points and demo purchasing points. Frontend provides a tabbed store experience with validation and toast feedback.

existing_features.title: Daily rewards claim (once per day) with streak tracking
existing_features.description: Daily reward grants points once per day, updates streak counters, and records a transaction. Frontend provides claim UI, eligibility gating, simple animations, and streak/balance stats.

existing_features.title: Daily Items Secret (daily mystery box)
existing_features.description: Daily mystery box feature supports checking eligibility, claiming a randomized item (points/badge/visual/message), showing animations, displaying the revealed item, and listing the last claimed item.

existing_features.title: Music uploads via ExternalBlob with friends’ music discovery
existing_features.description: Users can upload music files via ExternalBlob with upload progress; uploads are stored on the profile. Users can fetch and browse tracks uploaded by principals they follow, with playback controls in the UI.

existing_features.title: Premium membership and free trial lifecycle
existing_features.description: Backend supports upgrading to premium (with expiration) and a one-time 3-day free trial. Frontend Members-Only page gates content based on premium or active trial status and provides upgrade/trial actions.

existing_features.title: Search Engine Store (catalog + default provider + search history)
existing_features.description: Guests can browse available search engines; authenticated users can set a per-user default engine and view their recent search history recorded by the app.

existing_features.title: Advanced search engine page (voice search, math solver, AI voice, mock web search)
existing_features.description: Implements multi-tab search with browser voice recognition input, a safe on-device arithmetic/math solver with steps, optional spoken results controlled by settings, mocked web search results, and authenticated search history recording.

existing_features.title: Stripe + HTTP outcalls scaffolding (backend)
existing_features.description: Backend includes reusable HTTP GET/POST outcall helpers (with response header stripping via transform) and Stripe checkout session creation/status APIs plus admin-only Stripe configuration.

existing_features.title: Blob storage maintenance endpoints (backend mixin)
existing_features.description: Includes endpoints for authorized gateway principal registry updates, dead blob enumeration and confirmed deletion (with GC trigger), blob liveness checks, and cashier cycle refills.

existing_features.title: Frontend-only simulated modules and informational pages
existing_features.description: Implements several UI-only or simulated experiences: AI Song Generator, Videos (local object URL), Movies (sample listings), Radio, Live TV, Phone Protection scan, Robux Simulator, Creator Studio dashboard, Help/What’s New/Roadmap/Games Coming Soon pages.

existing_features.title: Theme toggle (light/dark) and design token theming
existing_features.description: Global theming via CSS variables with light/dark mode support and a header theme toggle; multiple themed color palettes exist for different app sections.

architectural_notes: Frontend is React + TypeScript using TailwindCSS and shadcn/ui primitives; lucide-react for icons; sonner for toast notifications.
Data fetching/mutations are centralized via @tanstack/react-query hooks (frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts), with query-key based caching and targeted invalidation on mutation success.
Authentication uses Internet Identity via @dfinity/auth-client in a context provider (useInternetIdentity).

Backend actor creation is identity-aware (useActor), cached via React Query; when authenticated, it calls a backend bootstrap method (_initializeAccessControlWithSecret) using a secret extracted from the URL hash/session to register roles.
Motoko backend uses in-memory state via mo:core Map and List collections; functional domains (authorization, blob storage) are composed via mixins included into the main actor.
Authorization is role-based (admin/user/guest) and enforced at canister entrypoints via AccessControl.hasPermission; admin setup depends on an environment token (CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN).
Chat message style metadata (color + effect) is supported in both DM and group messages; a migration module upgrades older stored message records by adding default style values.
Realtime-ish messaging is implemented via periodic polling/refetch (DMs ~3s; groups ~5s) plus auto-scroll to bottom when message arrays change.

Navigation is mixed: MainApp uses internal component state for most page switching, while some pages/components use TanStack Router navigation (e.g., /points, /search-engine-store), which can affect deep-linking/back behavior.

Voice features (speech recognition + speech synthesis) in the advanced search page are browser-dependent; settings for AI voice are persisted in localStorage and synchronized across tabs via storage events and a custom same-tab event.
known_issues: Follow/unfollow is stubbed: useFollowUser/useUnfollowUser throw “not yet implemented”, so follow UI cannot succeed.
Home feed and friend suggestions are stubbed: useGetHomeFeed/useGetFriendSuggestions return empty arrays, so those sections are always empty aside from the ‘What’s Recent’ statuses.

Backend content search is not implemented: useSearchContent returns empty results; advanced search tabs for apps/music/video/movie do not return real backend results (math solver and mock web search are the only functional result sources).
Published apps are not implemented end-to-end: useGetAllPublishedApps returns [] and usePublishApp throws “not yet implemented”, so PublishedApps is UI-only.
Live streams are not implemented end-to-end: useGetLiveStreams returns [] and create/stop stream mutations throw “not yet implemented”, so LiveStreams is UI-only.
Premium content listing is stubbed: useGetPremiumContent returns [], so MembersOnly cannot show real premium items.

Backend bug: updatePointsBalance sets points = amount when amount is positive (overwrites balance) instead of adding; can corrupt balances for features that use updatePointsBalance (e.g., mystery rewards).

Backend bug: Daily Items Secret claim gating uses dailyItemsRewardHistory.get(userId.toText()), but claims are stored under claimId (caller_time), so last-claim lookup can fail and allow/deny incorrectly.
Profile ‘status’ exists in types/UI state (EditProfileDialog) but is not actually saved/updated (backend updateProfile does not accept status; frontend doesn’t send it).
Deployment footgun: blob-storage expects env var CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL (triple “F”); misconfiguration traps at runtime.
RBAC bootstrap brittleness: _initializeAccessControlWithSecret traps if CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN is missing from canister env; authenticated actor creation will fail hard in that case.
Canister state is primarily in-memory Maps/Lists; without stable serialization and explicit upgrade hooks, data persistence across upgrades may be fragile.
Polling-based chat updates may be inefficient at scale compared to push/streaming approaches.
User reports group creation flow 'won’t let me create group' (may still be broken despite prior attempted fixes).
